Container.Name: OpenTodo
Container.Overview: Open-source, local-first task manager. Works offline and syncs every device from one small container. Projects, sections and boards, recurring tasks and reminders, sharing, CalDAV, an optional AI assistant, import from Todoist, Things, TickTick and Linear. No telemetry, no subscription. Open the Web UI and the first visitor creates the owner account. Installing the app, push notifications, passkeys and end-to-end encryption need https (a reverse proxy with a certificate); everything else works on the server's address.
Container.Requires: Nothing else. Data is one SQLite file in the appdata folder. Leave Use Tailscale off: the image has no shell, so Unraid's Tailscale script cannot run in it and the container would not start. For an https address on your tailnet, use Tailscale Serve on the Unraid server: https://github.com/pixari/opentodo/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/unraid.md#tailscale

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port the app and API answer on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything OpenTodo stores: the database, attachments and backups. Back up this folder.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: The address people open, for example https://todo.example.com. Needed behind a reverse proxy for passkeys, secure cookies and links in emails. Include the port if there is one. Leave empty when you open OpenTodo by the server's address.

Config.Name: Setup token
Config.Description: Optional, at least 16 characters. When set, creating the first (owner) account asks for this token, so a server reachable from the internet cannot be claimed by a stranger.

Config.Name: Open sign-up
Config.Description: true lets anyone who can reach the server create an account. Otherwise the owner invites people.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted for the visitor's address: IP addresses or ranges such as 192.0.2.0/24 separated by commas, or cloudflare. Set it only when every request comes through them.

Config.Name: Push notifications
Config.Description: on or off: reminders as push notifications (needs https).

Config.Name: Trash retention days
Config.Description: Days deleted items stay in the Trash; 0 keeps them forever.

Config.Name: Largest import (MB)
Config.Description: Largest import file accepted, in MB.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug, info, warn or error. The first log line shows the level in use; debug adds one line per request the app makes.
